rounds.blue_rationale: Red is a pure free-rider; the worst-off Blue is the cleaner who eats the public-goods cost. I shrink the dilemma itself: lower waste_spawn_prob (less cleaning needed), raise threshold_restoration (apples spawn at full rate even at 25% waste), widen the depletion buffer to 0.6, and slash clean_cost so cleaner-role Blues aren't bled dry. This lifts the worst-off Blue without giving Red's superior harvest-pathfinding extra apples to grab.

rounds.blue_rationale: Red exploits cleaner-vs-harvester asymmetry by racing the cooperator for apples; I minimize clean_cost (cleaners are the worst-off Blue), widen the maximal-spawn band (threshold_restoration=0.4) so cleaners spend more time as harvesters, and double apple_respawn_prob to dilute the zero-sum apple race. Beam stays off — the frozen cooperator never fires it, so enabling it only arms Red.
